title: ContactCompleted.v1
description: Payload of the ContactCompleted event (A§23). Emitted by contact-service — the single producer of contact events (A§7.2, plan §6.4) — when the result of a contact is recorded via `POST /v1/contacts/{contactId}/outcome`: an agent dispositioning a call, or treatment-service relaying a provider delivery webhook. Published on `collections.contact` keyed by `contactId`, so it always lands after the matching ContactAttempted on the same partition (A§26). Same identifiers as ContactAttempted plus the outcome, so a consumer can process the completion alone without holding the attempt. No message content is ever published (D§45). Rides the A§24 envelope; a breaking change ships as ContactCompleted.v2 (D§29).

contactId.description: Platform identifier of the contact record being completed — the same value as the ContactAttempted it concludes. Equal to the envelope `aggregateId` and the Kafka partition key (A§26).

caseId.description: Platform identifier (bare ULID) of the case this contact belongs to, or null for a customer-level contact with no open case. case-service appends a case activity when it is non-null (EXE-1). Nullable ULID: expressed as the envelope's ULID definition unioned with null, so the pattern lives in exactly one place (contracts/README §6) and is never re-declared here.

customerId.description: Platform identifier of the customer contacted. Repeated from the attempt so that frequency-cap and contactability consumers need no prior state.

channel.description: Channel the contact happened on — identical to the ContactAttempted value (D§9). Closed enum, because guardrails are configured per channel.

direction.description: OUTBOUND for platform-initiated contact, INBOUND for customer-initiated contact. Identical to the ContactAttempted value.

treatmentId.description: Platform identifier (bare ULID) of the treatment execution behind this contact, or null for a manual or inbound contact. Carries the decision-effectiveness join through to the outcome (A§47). Nullable ULID: expressed as the envelope's ULID definition unioned with null, so the pattern lives in exactly one place (contracts/README §6) and is never re-declared here.

outcome.description: How the contact ended. Open SCREAMING_SNAKE vocabulary rather than a closed enum: the disposition list is operationally owned, differs per channel (a letter is DELIVERED or RETURNED, a call is CONTACTED or NO_ANSWER) and grows without any change in event meaning — closing it would force a v2 for a new disposition code. Consumers branch only on the values they know; PROMISE_TO_PAY is the one value with cross-service meaning, since it is the disposition that precedes a PromiseCreated.
